name: node-dev
postCreateCommand: sudo chown -R node:node /workspaces/${localWorkspaceFolderBasename}/node_modules && sudo chown -R node:node /pnpm && corepack enable && corepack prepare pnpm@latest --activate && pnpm config set store-dir /pnpm && pnpm install
postStartCommand: sudo chown -R node:node /workspaces/${localWorkspaceFolderBasename}/node_modules && sudo chown -R node:node /pnpm
